svg.text: Proposed perfboard layout • component side • USB up
Placement concept, not a solder-side wiring template; exact board size unconfirmed
Common ground bus • controller current only
Off-board: PSU → fused pixel power cable → first pixel +12V / GND
Join controller and pixel grounds. Never connect 12V to XIAO or buffer.
330Ω near first pixel DIN for a short lead; final termination depends on cable length.
Insulating mounts • accessible USB • keep antenna away from metal • no mains on perfboard
